# Python

_SKOS concept in the [PKM Vocabulary](../)._

A general-purpose, interpreted programming language.

## Scope note

Tags PKM automation written in Python - e.g. pkm-neo4j-service and CLI scripts (pkm-day, pkm-health, pkm-pte) - as distinct from Swift components.
